mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 35 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Harriet Park and the first quarter moon is visible. Also, the ISS will pass overhead tonight, rising over Mount Horeb and heading toward the Northeast near Madison, reaching high in the sky.

The City of Verona has released several notices regarding the upcoming November 2026 general election, and the park and recreation department has posted updated standings for both men's and coed leagues.
Currently, there are no public events scheduled in the city for the next 30 days, but we will keep you updated as new community gatherings are added to the calendar.
On October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, which resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until closing time at 10 PM.
